wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-003 wires the BT_USE button through the usedown debounce into P_UseLines via a new src/vanilla facade (wirePlayerUseAction.ts) that re-exports the read-only src/player/implement-player-use-action.ts (classifyVanillaPlayerUseAction debounce) and src/world/useLines.ts (P_UseLines ray cast + spechit-overrun emulation) and adds applyPlayerUseAction(input, useLinesAction): it runs classifyVanillaPlayerUseAction and invokes the use action thunk iff fireUseEvent (the rising edge), returning the outcome so the caller stores player.usedown = nextUsedown. The thunk seam (caller binds () => useLines(player.mo, mapData, callbacks)) keeps the rising-edge gating unit-testable without constructing a full map and avoids the banned as/as-unknown casts that a typed Mobj/MapData sentinel would have required (no test factories exist for those types). VANILLA_PLAYER_USE_INVARIANTS pins four parity rules anchored to Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 p_user.c P_PlayerThink + p_map.c P_UseLines: edge-triggered usedown, useLines fires only on the rising edge, player/world USERANGE agree at 64*FRACUNIT, and a blocking non-special wall plays sfx_noway (20). The focused test uses line-anchored import-specifier parsing and dynamic await import identity checks so the test file adds no inventory importer.
wiringInterpretation.inventoryNeutralityNote: src/player/implement-player-use-action.ts is not tracked by any plan_vanilla_parity manifest. Only src/world/useLines.ts (inventory-map-and-world-modules.json) drifts, src-side only, from the unavoidable facade re-export; bumped to keep manifest==reality, matching the 09-001/09-002 precedent.
